guitar.notes: Paul Kossoff is well documented as a classic Gibson Les Paul player (1959 Les Paul Standard), influential blues-rock tone.

tone.target: dirty open-tuned rock crunch with wah and fuzz edge
tone.profile: dirty open-tuned rock crunch with wah and fuzz edge
tone.summary: A high-gain, fuzzy signal chain utilizing a pre-drive (OD 9/Green OD), Wah filter, Fuzz distortion, followed by an aggressive British amp model (UK 45) and a robust 4x12 cabinet, finished with subtle reverb.
